text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to limit sugar and junk food. Second, exercise regularly. Even a 30-minute walk each day can make a big difference. Third, get enough sleep—most adults need seven to eight hours a night. Don't forget your mental health, too. Talk to friends, take breaks, and find time to relax. Finally, keep a good work-life balance. If you spend all your time working, you will feel tired and stressed. Small daily habits lead to a healthier, happier life.
